name: z-ai/glm-4.5-air
description: GLM-4.5-Air is the lightweight member of Z.ai's GLM-4.5 family, a mixture-of-experts model with 106B total and 12B active parameters built as a foundation model for agent-oriented applications. It offers hybrid reasoning, with a thinking mode for complex reasoning and tool use and a non-thinking mode for instant replies, and is tuned for tool calling, web browsing, software engineering and front-end development. Choose GLM-4.5 for more capacity.
